captions.instagram:
Class 11 Maths · Trigonometric Functions
Maths, visualised #1 · Where do the sin and cos waves come from? 🌀

One point going round a circle draws both:
🟢 its height is sin θ
🔵 its width is cos θ
Turn the cos wave onto the sine axes and slide it 90° right: it lands exactly on the sine wave. cos θ = sin(θ + 90°). Same wave, a quarter turn apart.

On your syllabus: Class 11 Trigonometric Functions, and every trig question in JEE Main and the boards.
